_comment: This is the ONLY source of truth for what a mod can do. A player's uploaded mod JSON is never executed — its effect_id is looked up here, and if (and only if) it matches, the fixed effect + value below is what gets applied. Nothing from the player's file is ever eval'd, parsed as logic, or trusted for magnitude.

cheats.label: Undying Grace
cheats.description: Prevents inventory items from being dropped/lost on death.

cheats.label: Coin Ward
cheats.description: Prevents solars from being lost on death.

cheats.label: Unbreaking Grip
cheats.description: Equipped gear no longer loses durability from combat use.

cheats.label: Swift Revival
cheats.description: Reduces post-death revive cooldown by 50%.

cheats.label: Heavy Hand
cheats.description: Small flat boost to outgoing combat damage.

cheats.label: Titan Breaker
cheats.description: Adds 15% PvE damage against enemies with more than 3,000 DEF.

cheats.label: Lucky Edge
cheats.description: Adds flat crit chance percentage.

cheats.label: Relentless Pursuit
cheats.description: Reduces boss re-attempt cooldown by 25%.

cheats.label: Free Passage
cheats.description: Waives the currency cost to enter a boss fight.

cheats.label: Quick Study
cheats.description: Flat percentage boost to XP earned.

cheats.label: Golden Touch
cheats.description: Flat percentage boost to solars earned from drops.

cheats.label: Merchant's Favor
cheats.description: Percentage discount on game-shop purchases.

cheats.label: No Toll
cheats.description: Waives the listing fee when posting to the auction house.

cheats.label: Glimmer Sight
cheats.description: Flat percentage boost to shiny/rare spawn rate.

cheats.label: Steady Hands
cheats.description: Flat percentage boost to catch success rate.

cheats.label: Second Chance
cheats.description: One free pet stat re-roll per day, no cost.

cheats.label: Efficient Hands
cheats.description: Percentage reduction in crafting material cost.

cheats.label: Self-Mending
cheats.description: Gear repairs cost no materials or currency.

cheats.label: Restless Wanderer
cheats.description: Reduces spawn/encounter cooldown by 20%.

cheats.label: Double Dawn
cheats.description: Grants one additional daily reward claim per day.

cheats.label: Modder's Mark
cheats.description: Displays a small cosmetic badge next to your name. No gameplay effect.
